textos.As visões divergem ao avaliar as compara: Views diverge when assessing comparisons with other productions: about half of those who recommend it value the protagonist's evolution in driving the plot, while, in a small sample, about half of those who do not recommend it find the narrative pace excessively slow and tiring.
textos.Muitos espectadores relataram que a dura: Many viewers reported that the long running time and drawn-out pace made the experience tiring, with some admitting they fell asleep or had trouble paying attention from start to finish.
textos.Uma parcela significativa do grupo consi: A significant share of the group felt that the film's high reputation does not match what they watched, saying it is highly praised without deserving so much, which raised expectations and ended in disappointment.
textos.Alguns espectadores mencionaram que a hi: Some viewers mentioned that the story failed to hold them, with a narrative that seemed disjointed or hard to follow, leaving them feeling lost or uninterested in the events.
textos.Apesar das críticas negativas, um ponto: Despite the negative reviews, a recurring positive point was Al Pacino's performance, praised for its youthfulness and charisma, and named as one of the few aspects that held viewers' attention.
textos.O grupo comentou que há muita conversa e: The group commented that there is a lot of talk and little happening, with long dialogue scenes that drag on without advancing the story, contributing to a feeling of stagnation.
textos.Preferência por outros filmes ou gêneros: Preference for other films or genres
textos.Alguns espectadores afirmaram que a temá: Some viewers stated that the mafia theme does not appeal to them, or that they prefer works by other directors or even other genres, which kept the film from pleasing them.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas apontam que o fi: Many middling reviews point out that the film is slow and excessively long, with scenes that could be cut without loss.
textos.Um grupo considerável menciona que, por: A considerable group mentions that, because it is regarded as one of the best films of all time, they expected more and ended up disappointed, finding it overrated.
textos.Várias reviews elogiam as atuações, espe: Several reviews praise the performances, especially those of Al Pacino and Marlon Brando, saying they elevate the film, although some find Brando's performance exaggerated.
textos.Algumas reviews criticam a forma como as: Some reviews criticize the way women are portrayed, as superficial or left in the background, which bothers viewers especially from a feminist perspective.
textos.A fotografia e a direção de arte são fre: The cinematography and art direction are frequently praised, with many recognizing the visual beauty and technical competence, even when the narrative does not fully appeal.
textos.Algumas reviews reconhecem o impacto do: Some reviews recognize the film's impact on the mafia genre and on cinema as a whole, but question whether that justifies its high rating today.
textos.As performances são amplamente elogiadas: The performances are widely praised, with emphasis on Marlon Brando and Al Pacino, whose acting conveys the complexity and transformation of their characters.
textos.Muitas reviews destacam a jornada de Mic: Many reviews highlight Michael's journey, from a reluctant young man to a cold and ruthless leader, as the heart of the film, with a convincing and well-built evolution.
textos.A direção, fotografia, design de produçã: The direction, cinematography, production design and music are considered impeccable, creating a dense, engrossing atmosphere that transports the viewer into the world of the mafia.
textos.Exploração de temas familiares e de pode: Exploration of family and power themes
textos.As reviews positivas valorizam a abordag: The positive reviews value the film's treatment of loyalty, family, power and corruption, showing how crime is intertwined with personal relationships.
textos.Embora alguns achem o ritmo arrastado, a: Although some find the pace slow, most consider the running time justified, with a careful development that sustains interest and makes the film an immersive experience.
textos.Diversas cenas são citadas como inesquec: Several scenes are cited as unforgettable, such as the baptism and the opening of the wedding, highlighting the symbolism and narrative power that became landmarks of cinema.

textos.Lançado em 1972 e dirigido por Francis F: Released in 1972 and directed by Francis Ford Coppola, The Godfather is a crime drama set in New York. The plot follows the influential mafia family headed by Don Corleone amid power struggles and attacks that lead his son Michael, until then distanced from the family business, to take on the protection of his father and his legacy.
textos.A experiência do longa-metragem se apoia: The feature's experience rests on a measured narrative pace, an extensive structure and strong dramatic density.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliam os mesmos a: The different groups assess the same aspects of the work and agree on what the film is, differing essentially in the verdict on how well it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), the reception is one of acclaim: the largest share highlights the striking performances, about half emphasize Michael Corleone's transformation and a good portion stress the production's technical and visual mastery.
textos.Numa fração mínima das notas (~5%), sob: In a tiny fraction of ratings (~5%), from the perspective of this middling group, a significant share point to the slow pace and long running time as causes of fatigue, a considerable number mention high expectations not met, while some value the standout performances of Marlon Brando and Al Pacino. In an even smaller fraction of ratings (~2%), among those who rated it negatively, half of them complain about the slow pace and a sense of boredom, several consider the film overrated and many report difficulty connecting with the plot.
